findings.what: amountToSend checks a 'clean number' with Number(), which also reads hex, binary and exponent text: '0x10' goes out as 16 and '1e2' as 100, numbers nobody typed.
findings.why: Finding I2 and its delegated ruling say an amount that is not a clean number is sent as typed, so the API's 400 answers it (HONEST-1: no invented value). The function's own doc comment promises the same. Number() accepts 0x/0b/0o and exponent forms, so those few inputs still get converted on the page. The red tests pin only 'abc' and '', so they can't catch this. It's an edge case and doesn't block, but the check should be a decimal pattern, not Number.isFinite.
